description: This file sets up and renders a 3D model of a ship using a graphics library. It includes functions for initializing the scene, creating a window, loading the model, and drawing it with user interactions like mouse press detection and camera controls.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the window and loads the 3D ship model, enabling debug mode.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Handles rendering the scene, applying transformations, displaying the model, and handling user interaction for visual effects.
